card.intro: Connect your Odoo to see its items, units, warehouses and accounts in PMO, and keep vendors and clients in step.
card.pickCompany: Choose the Odoo company PMO works with. It cannot be changed later.
card.askAdmin: An administrator needs to choose the Odoo company.
card.location: Self-hosted or Odoo-hosted ERP: your data stays in your Odoo; PMO keeps a read copy of its directories.

connect.subtitle: Use an API key made for PMO in Odoo. PMO stores it encrypted and never shows it again.
connect.expiryHelp: If you gave the key an expiry in Odoo, enter it so PMO can warn you before it lapses.

discard.title: Switch to a different Odoo database
discard.body: This is a different Odoo database. Connecting discards what PMO mirrored from the old one (directories and links). Documents already sent are never touched.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Odoo
disconnect.body: PMO stops syncing with Odoo and deletes the stored API key. What PMO already mirrored stays visible until you connect again.

checklist.connectedHint: PMO can read your Odoo with the stored key.
checklist.activatedHint: Pick the Odoo company PMO works with.
checklist.capabilityHint: Checked when the company is chosen and on every re-check.
checklist.mapOnceHint: Accounts, units and the default warehouse, proposed together and accepted in one step.
checklist.sendsHint: Records PMO holds that Odoo should also have are sent once.
checklist.employ: Vendors and clients managed in Odoo
checklist.employHint: After this, Odoo owns vendor and client records.
checklist.title: Odoo setup

error.anotherErpActive: Another accounting system is already connected. Disconnect it first.
error.destinationRefused: That address cannot be used. Use the public https address of your Odoo.
error.unreachable: Odoo could not be reached. Check the address and try again.
error.timeout: Odoo did not answer in time. Try again.
error.tls: Odoo's security certificate could not be verified.
error.notOdoo: That address does not look like an Odoo instance.
error.noJson2: This Odoo does not offer the JSON-2 API. Odoo 20 or later is needed.
error.unsupportedVersion: This Odoo version is not supported. Odoo 20 or later is needed.
error.databaseNotFound: Odoo has no database with that name, or its API is not reachable at this address.
error.keyRejected: Odoo rejected the API key. Check the key and try again.
error.accessDenied: The API key works but cannot read companies.
error.missingModel: This Odoo is missing an app PMO needs.
error.targetLocked: Documents already reference the current Odoo connection, so it cannot be switched to another database.
error.companyLocked: This connection is locked to the company chosen first.
error.companyNotFound: That company is not available to this key.
error.rateLimited: This was just run. Try again in a minute.
error.syncRunning: A sync is running. Try again in a minute.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed. Try again.
